excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: If it's not there, it's just an incorrectly formatted https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#engine_forkchoiceupdatedv1 -- it's part of the `PayloadAttributesV1` structure. So it's never exactly missing, just potentially not valid.

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: as in, some nonsensical address. It's going to be a valid 160-bit number, or else it can be rejected for syntax reasons by the EL
